description: This file defines a utility class 'TestUtils' with static methods for converting iterables to lists and maps, and contains constants related to API levels for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for list and map conversions, and constants for API levels.

methods.name: convertToList
methods.description: Converts an Iterable of type T into a List of T.

methods.name: convertToMap
methods.description: Converts an Iterable of objects O into a Map with keys of type K and values of type V, using a parser function to extract key-value pairs.
